audit.why: 46.01% over 1380 games, TRICKY 7/10: Mel farms an easy pre-6, then survives an assassin. Ratings fit the data.

audit.whatIsWrong: The layers currently disagree at Level 6: full phases[4].side=Diana but content win[4]=Mel; the other six full rows are 'Skill'. Content's own prose (spikes[1], late) says everything flips at 6, so win[4] is the wrong one. phases[5-6].why also describe Mel winning stages both layers give to Diana.
audit.why: Level 6 is Diana's spike: Moonfall completes the Q-E dive into pull-and-burst. Packet levelChart[4]=Mel is contradicted by the packet's own WR defect note and all prose.
audit.corrected: win[4] Mel->Diana with rewritten why; full rows 0-3 -> Mel, 5-6 -> Diana with matching whys and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly names Diana's ultimate 'Lunar Rush' — Lunar Rush is her E dash (22s, resets on Moonlight-marked targets); her R is Moonfall, the pull-and-burst. whys[1] also claims she has no gap-closer at level 2, which her E disproves. Plus: no digit in breakdown.cooldowns, two pasted trade-line bullets, 21 misgendered fields.
audit.why: Packet enemyAbilities and kit: Q Crescent Strike 8s, W Pale Cascade 15s, E Lunar Rush 22s (dash, no-cooldown vs Moonlight), R Moonfall 100s. The wrong slot changes the advice: her gap-close exists pre-6; what 6 adds is the pull-burst finisher.
audit.corrected: Every Lunar-Rush-as-R reference rewritten to Moonfall/E correctly; cooldown numbers added; bleed and pronoun fixes applied.
